title: Vice City's Dark History: How a City Was Built on Crime
thesis: Vice City was not corrupted by Tommy Vercetti. He inherited an existing system of corruption and criminal power.

chapters.title: A City That Was Already Waiting
chapters.purpose: Hook. Open on the city, not violence (first 15 seconds stay calm for ad suitability). Pose the question: who really ran Vice City before Tommy? Brief GTA VI framing at setting level only.

chapters.title: Boomtown, 1984
chapters.purpose: Context: the 3D-universe city, its real-world model, the drug-money boom. One line separating the 2D original.

chapters.title: The Sergeant
chapters.purpose: Evidence 1: the Army. Martinez runs drugs through Fort Baxter for the cartel and discards Vic.

chapters.title: The Agent
chapters.purpose: Evidence 2: law enforcement. Forbes sells deal information; his ID becomes a weapon. Say plainly that his agency is disputed.

chapters.title: The Cartel's Tower
chapters.purpose: Evidence 3: the cartel's respectable front, the Mendez war, and the 'Last Stand' ending.

chapters.title: The Exchange
chapters.purpose: 1984 to 1986: Lance pulls Vic back in; a retired colonel helps broker the deal that becomes the ambush.

chapters.title: The Heir
chapters.purpose: Tommy steps into Diaz's empire and a developer's gang-war scheme: he inherits and accelerates the system rather than creating it.

chapters.title: This Is Business
chapters.purpose: The finale as the system's verdict: Sonny, Lance, what is said vs implied about Harwood; the Sonny theory clearly labelled as a fan theory.

chapters.title: The System Outlives Its Kings
chapters.purpose: Conclusion: restate the thesis on the evidence; aftermath; GTA VI's Vice City as an open question, no story spoilers.
